name: @metorial/amplitude
description: Ingest events, query analytics, download exports, and manage cohorts, taxonomy, user properties, annotations, and privacy requests through Amplitude REST APIs. Discover projects, events, properties, flags, and experiments; compare exposure-to-conversion funnels; create downloadable dashboard and notebook reports; and check saved-chart thresholds on demand. OAuth enables saved-chart discovery and reports. Experiment management reads require a separate management API key. Search users, inspect event history, download session replay chunks and cohort members, and query acquisition-cohort revenue lifetime value and five-minute active users using project credentials.
